## Character-length control with diffusion language models {#delta}

**Training-Free Character-Length Control in Summarization with Diffusion Language Models**, EMNLP 2026 (main conference)

DELTA controls the character length of summaries generated by masked diffusion language models without fine-tuning. It adjusts masked positions during generation and reduces length errors by roughly an order of magnitude across three benchmarks, while maintaining summary quality. Developed within [GenKI4Media](#genki4media) for applications such as headlines and previews.

[PDF](assets/papers/castle2026delta.pdf)

## Hallucination detection from model internals {#hallucination-detection}

Research within [GenKI4Media](#genki4media) on detecting whether generated answers are supported by retrieved documents. The approach examines contributions from source text and previously generated tokens in the residual stream, using these signals for training-free and supervised detection.

An extended abstract appeared at BlackboxNLP 2026. A full paper is forthcoming. A related poster was presented at the AI Grid Summer School in Paris.

## GUARDRAIL {#guardrail}

**Grounded Uncertainty-Aware Reasoning with Deferrable, Reliable Abstention In LLMs**

A Franco-German AI for Science 2026 proposal on making LLM-generated knowledge graphs more reliable. Source evidence and uncertainty are retained with extracted facts and used for retrieval, climate-related claim verification (ClimateCheck), and deciding when the system should abstain. The work also considers plant- and pest-related question answering.

**Partners:** DFKI Berlin, University of Bamberg (Cognitive Systems), Lamarr Institute / University of Bonn, Université Paris-Saclay, and INRAE MaIAGE. Developed at the AI for Science Summer School (AI Grid, DataIA, SCAI), coordinated from DFKI Berlin.

## NEXUS {#nexus}

**Knowledge-Driven and Interpretable Reranking for Scientific Document Retrieval** (Neuro-symbolic EXplainable Scientific Search)

A Franco-German AI for Science 2026 proposal on improving scientific search with domain ontologies. Documents and queries are linked to ontology concepts, aligned across ontologies with expert-checked LLM suggestions, and compared through late-interaction reranking. This also shows which concepts explain the ranking, evaluated on biomedical literature.

**Partners:** DFKI Berlin, TIB Hannover, Friedrich Schiller University Jena, and Université de Technologie de Compiègne (BMBI Laboratory). Developed at the AI for Science Summer School (AI Grid, DataIA, SCAI). The DFKI contribution covers concept representations, reranking, and explanation evaluation.

## GenKI4Media {#genki4media}

**Generative AI assistants for the media, cultural and creative sectors** (BMFTR, 2025 to present)

Developing more reliable AI tools for editorial work by checking generated content against external sources. The DFKI work focuses on hallucination detection and precise text-length control.

**Partners:** 3pc, ART+COM, Fraunhofer FOKUS, dpa, and Deutsche Welle.

## XPO (Software Campus) {#xpo}

**Explainability-guided prompt optimization and repair** (Software Campus, 2026)

A 12-month project led in collaboration with Celonis, using model explanations to identify and fix problems in prompts for enterprise LLM workflows.

## Data4Transparency {#data4transparency}

**Information extraction for investigative journalism** (2023 to 2024, with OCCRP)

Using few-shot named-entity recognition and relation extraction to help investigative journalists find people, organisations, and connections in large document collections.

## Green-AI Hub: entity linking for product carbon footprint estimation {#green-ai-hub}

**Green-AI Hub Mittelstand** (BMUV, 2024)

Using language models to match manufacturing components with environmental impact data and simplify carbon footprint calculations. Developed with a manufacturing SME and published as *Entity Linking using LLMs for Automated Product Carbon Footprint Estimation* (2025).

[PDF](assets/papers/castle2025ecolink.pdf)

## PLASS: explanation-based drift detection {#plass}

**Platform for Analytical Supply Chain Management Services** (BMWi, 2020 to 2022, led by Siemens)

Extracting supply-chain risks from multilingual news and using model explanations to detect changes in input data. This work led to *Detecting Covariate Drift with Explanations* (NLPCC XAI Workshop, 2021).

[PDF](https://www.dfki.de/fileadmin/user_upload/import/11753_Detecting_Covariate_Drift_with_Explanations.pdf) · [Code](https://github.com/DFKI-NLP/xai-shift-detection)
